# CRP (ED, 2WK & M6)

## Data prep 
```{r}
# load cytokine data
CRP_data_full <- read.csv("Data/CRP Data/Data Files/AURORA_ALL_CRP_1471_raw.csv")

# constants
LLOQ <- 0.00164
ULOQ <- 2.5

CRP_data_analysis <- CRP_data_full %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    CRP_raw = CRP_MEAN.CONC..mg.dL..accounting.for.dilution) %>%
  mutate(
    PID = as.character(PID),
    
    # impute
    CRP_imputed = case_when(
      Range == "LLOQ" ~ LLOQ / sqrt(2),
      Range == "ULOQ" ~ ULOQ,
      TRUE ~ CRP_raw),
    
    # log transform
    CRP_log = log2(CRP_imputed + 1),
    
    # harmonize time
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
      "T0" = "ED",
      "T1" = "WK2",
      "T2" = "M6",
      "T3" = "M6"),
    
    # unified technical variable
    Plate = factor(Plate_new)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, InventoryCode_New, Timepoint, Plate,
                CRP_raw, CRP_log, Batch = batch)
```

## Batch effects 
There were no batch effects observed according to the Executive Summary, while there were minor plate effects noted.  

CRP values were log-transformed and adjusted for plate effects by fitting a linear model with plate as a predictor. Plate-adjusted CRP values were calculated as model residuals re-centered to the overall mean log-CRP value.
```{r}
# fit model
fit_plate <- lm(CRP_log ~ Plate, data = CRP_data_analysis)

# ANOVA + effect size
crp_plate_summary <- anova(fit_plate) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
  mutate(
    partial_R2 = `Sum Sq` / sum(`Sum Sq`),
    Feature = "CRP",
    n = nrow(CRP_data_analysis),
    mean = mean(CRP_data_analysis$CRP_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(CRP_data_analysis$CRP_log, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Term, Df, `Sum Sq`, `Mean Sq`, `F value`, 
                `Pr(>F)`, partial_R2, n, mean, sd)


# export
write.csv(crp_plate_summary, "Data/CRP Data/Analysis Data/CRP_Batch_Effect_Summary_3-23-2026.csv")

crp_plate_df <- CRP_data_analysis %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, InventoryCode_New, Plate, Timepoint, CRP_log) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()


crp_plate_df <- crp_plate_df %>%
  mutate(
    CRP_log_adj = resid(fit_crp_plate) +
      mean(CRP_log, na.rm = TRUE))

# check removal of plate effect
anova(lm(CRP_log_adj ~ Plate, data = crp_plate_df))

# merge back
CRP_data_analysis <- CRP_data_analysis %>%
  left_join(
    crp_plate_df %>% dplyr::select(PID, InventoryCode_New, CRP_log_adj),
    by = c("PID", "InventoryCode_New"))


```

## Data for analysis 
```{r}
CRP_data_analysis_EDM6 <- CRP_data_analysis %>%
  filter(
    PID %in% PIDs_245_ED6M,
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)

dim(CRP_data_analysis_EDM6) # 460 x 8 

write.csv(CRP_data_analysis_EDM6, "Data/CRP Data/Analysis Data/CRP_Data_EDM6_460_3-23-2026.csv")

CRP_data_analysis_ED2WKM6 <- CRP_data_analysis %>%
  filter(
    PID %in% PIDs_40_ED2WK6M,
    Timepoint %in% c("ED","WK2", "M6")) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)

dim(CRP_data_analysis_ED2WKM6) # 54 x 8 

write.csv(CRP_data_analysis_ED2WKM6, "Data/CRP Data/Analysis Data/CRP_Data_ED2WKM6_54_3-23-2026.csv")


```

## Normality
```{r}
# function to summarize a single vector
summarize_crp <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    N = sum(is.finite(x)),
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Skewness = e1071::skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
    Kurtosis = e1071::kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2))
}

# build comparison table
crp_normality_summary <- bind_rows(
  
  summarize_crp(CRP_data_analysis$CRP_raw) %>%
    mutate(Scale = "Raw"),
  
  summarize_crp(CRP_data_analysis$CRP_log_adj) %>%
    mutate(Scale = "Log2")) %>%
  relocate(Scale)

crp_normality_summary

write.csv(crp_normality_summary, "Data/CRP Data/Analysis Data/CRP_Stat_Summary_3-23-2026.csv")

```
